reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because the creator promotes joining Mirror Trading International through a referral link in exchange for promised direct referrals and team-building benefits. It directs viewers to join through the description link and send their name and referral link so the creator can cycle the URL among recruits, creating a recruitment-based benefit rather than presenting neutral analysis or reporting. The video therefore contains an observable solicitation involving enrollment in a trading/referral scheme and consequential participation.

citations.quote: every one that gonna join to my team from this video only not from other videos from this video I am going to change the link in my description to izreferra link
everyone that's going to join me please send me in the comment or in my telegram channel
send me your name and your raf link
i'm going to change my raf link to yours
promise one direct if it's going well maybe we'll do it later for two directs

opening.argument: Judge the offer by its stated limits. The speaker commits to one referral, but makes any expansion conditional, saying “if it's going well maybe” rather than promising an escalating benefit. He also says he can handle only half the team-building work and leaves the rest to the viewer. That is a narrower proposal than a promise that joining will produce a complete team or guaranteed income. The stated condition is joining, not liking or subscribing. These qualifications support reading the video as a limited referral promotion, without treating the proposed referral as proof of a financial payoff.

citations.quote: promise one direct if it's going well maybe we'll do it later for two directs
I can be responsible for the half of the way you need to do the second half it's yours
The only condition is to join me!

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited invitation to join and submit a referral link establishes a promotion, but not a promised return on money or an assured stream of recruits. The speaker describes changing the link after one direct referral, then moving to another participant. His separate qualification about any future two-referral offer matters: the prosecution's quote should not be read as an unlimited promise.

citations.quote: i'm going to change my raf link to yours okay i'm going to do it until i'm going to see that you get one direct referrers gift for me after that I'm going to switch the URL to another one
promise one direct if it's going well maybe we'll do it later for two directs

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The uncertainty applies to a possible second referral, not the core solicitation. The speaker tells viewers to join through his MTI referral link and says he will rotate the description link to each participant. Saying that viewers must build the other half of their team does not make this merely a qualified personal account; it confirms that team recruitment is the benefit being promoted.

citations.quote: join me for this video to my referral link for MTI and I'm going to change in the description the referral to you and so on and so on and so on to each one that going to join us
you need to do the second half it's yours

opening.argument: The speaker spends the video explaining a specific way to coordinate referral links: a participant sends a name and link, the description link is changed until that participant receives one direct referral, and the process moves to someone else. The sampled dashboard shows team and referral metrics alongside other account information. Read together, these details make the video an operational walk-through of how the proposed rotation would work. A judge can recognize that viewers are invited to participate without overlooking that the substance is a concrete, limited procedure, not a claim that the dashboard proves anyone will profit.

citations.quote: send me your name and your raf link and i'm going to change my raf link to yours
after that I'm going to switch the URL to another one

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution quotes the proposed steps accurately, but those same quotes describe what the speaker will do with submitted links. Showing a referral dashboard and explaining a link rotation do not, by themselves, demonstrate a payout or a completed recruitment chain. The video can be read as explaining a proposed team workflow, even though participation is invited.

citations.quote: send me your name and your raf link
i'm going to change my raf link to yours

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Explaining the procedure does not make instruction the video's primary purpose. The speaker explicitly asks viewers to join through his MTI referral link and offers to publish theirs in turn. The dashboard supplies context for the referral and team structure, but the decisive evidence is the spoken invitation tying enrollment to a promised direct referral.

citations.quote: join me for this video to my referral link for MTI
let's start it with one direct referral for each one of you

opening.argument: What is actually offered is a referral placement: join through the speaker's link, provide a name and referral link, and have that link published until it receives one direct referral. Referral promotions can be judged on their observed terms. Here, the request for participant information is limited in the speech to a name and link; the cited offer does not ask viewers to send funds or credentials, and it does not state a guaranteed investment return. The dashboard shows referral and bonus fields, but a displayed field is not evidence that this particular offer pays the viewer. The supported reading is a recruitment-based promotion, not proof of a financial transfer or payout promise.

citations.quote: send me your name and your raf link and i'm going to change my raf link to yours
every time I see that you have direct file for me I'm going to change it to then to another one

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution establishes that the speaker solicits enrollment and offers a referral in return. Its quotes do not establish a deposit request, a credential request, or a guaranteed financial return. The fact that he plans to replace each participant's link after one referral also limits what is promised. Calling the invitation consequential does not fill in those missing elements.

citations.quote: after that I'm going to switch the URL to another one
let's start it with one direct referral for each one of you

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The absence of an explicit deposit or guaranteed return does not erase the mechanism the video does show. The speaker directs viewers to join his MTI team through his referral link, then offers a direct referral and cycles the link to the next recruit. The dashboard's team, referral, and bonus metrics reinforce that this is recruitment within a tiered structure, not an isolated giveaway unrelated to enrollment.
